verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents a single SPFresh vector index that is 'automatically tuned for 90-100% recall'. There is no evidence of user-exposed HNSW or graph parameters or selectable ANN index types. Exact kNN search and marking attributes `filterable: false` are adjacent features, not index-parameter tuning, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can tune index parameters (HNSW graph settings, index types) to trade recall against latency and memory
